claim: A user must not be able to bulk-cancel orders that belong to another user.
When the same order ID appears more than once in the bulk-cancel list, it must not appear in both the cancelled and skipped response arrays.
Sending a bulk-cancel request with the order_ids field absent must return 400.
Stock must not be restored when an unauthorized user attempts to bulk-cancel another user's order.
Sending order_ids as a non-list value must not produce a 5xx server error.
